description: Use to stop a watch: a tracked route or one itinerary in it (fid), a tracked stay or one hotel in it (hotel_id), a seat alert, or a bucket list. Cannot be undone; confirm first.

fid.description: [flight] An itinerary's fid from watch_list, to stop only that one and keep the route.

hotel_id.description: [hotel] Drop only this hotel from the stay and keep the rest.

kind.description: The watch's kind: flight (a tracked route), hotel (a tracked stay), seat (a seat alert) or bucket_list (a flight or hotel bucket list).

watch.description: The watch's id from watch_list: its search_key (flight), tracking_id (hotel), tracking_key (seat) or bucket_id (bucket_list).

name: watch_stop

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

display_name.description: Name as the card shows it

fid.description: The single itinerary removed, if any

hotel_id.description: The single hotel removed, if any

manage_url.description: flight: slicktrip.com saved-flights page link; bucket_list: slicktrip.com saved buckets page link

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

note.description: Set when last hotel removal deleted the stay

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

route.description: flight: Route dict parsed from the key with place names; bucket_list: Flight only: origin, destination, names, trip_type, cabin, travelers

scope.description: flight: "one itinerary" or "whole route"; hotel: "whole stay" or "one hotel"

status.description: flight: stopped | error | sign_in_required; hotel: stopped | error | sign_in_required; seat: stopped | error | sign_in_required; bucket_list: removed | error | sign_in_required

stay.description: hotel: location, hotel_name, name, check_in, check_out, adults; bucket_list: Hotel only: location, hotel_name, nights, adults

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

title: Stop a watch
